findings.text: The "Owner decision and evidence" section says "no model implementation has changed" and "keeps current engine selection". The section at line 42 says implementation work is in progress, and the accepted correction changes the shared NULL test. Fix: mark line 28 as historical (as of the first audit), or change it to say that the convenience path follows the corrected engine selection.

The text says the `repeated-unused-null-write` and `repeated-unused-null-pragma` differential regressions "retain the finding" as if they exist. The commit does not add them, and the same section says the source edits are uncommitted and not yet changed for this decision. Fix: say that these regressions are planned or uncommitted in the FK workspace, and that none is in the repository yet.
